payload.claim: `REJECTED` (and `MERGED`) are excluded from `PR_PENDING_STATES`, so a task is never re-asked about once closed-unmerged. If an operator reopens a closed pull request on GitHub and later merges it (GitHub permits this), the task stays `REJECTED` forever with no path back to `MERGED`. This mirrors the deliberate 'never re-ask MERGED' rule but was only justified for `MERGED` in the spec; it is a minor, unlikely-in-practice gap rather than something requiring action now.
